reason: The replication of Experiment 1a (footbridge personal-force contrast) compares two mutually exclusive between-subjects groups in a Welch independent t-test: Footbridge Pole (Condition 2, n = 74) and Footbridge Switch (Condition 3, n = 86), totaling 74 + 86 = 160 analytic participants after study-wide exclusions.

The replication of Experiment 1b (speedboat personal-force contrast) compares two mutually exclusive between-subjects groups in a Welch independent t-test: Speedboat Oar (Condition 2, n = 74) and Speedboat Accelerate (Condition 3, n = 86), totaling 74 + 86 = 160 analytic participants after study-wide exclusions.
